gen-megrim-gf-ramabhadra: Angular, a bit sci-fi, drawn as if with one fine pen tip: that is Megrim up top. And Ramabhadra takes over below with a tall, clean sans-serif body that feels grounded next to it.
gen-megrim-gf-rambla: Megrim's strokes all end at one measured thickness, like a wire bent into letters. Rambla, a plain sans with small letters nearly as tall as its capitals, would hold up fine if the heading were made small.
gen-megrim-gf-recursive: Futuristic and sharp-cornered, Megrim draws its letters with a lean, wiry line and a skyward x-height. Then Recursive steps in with a friendly, modern sans body whose tall mean line makes the text feel approachable.
gen-megrim-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed reads as if the text were magnified, steady in weight from one word to the next. Megrim is the one for angular, futuristic display, while the sans-serif body does the quiet work.
gen-megrim-gf-secular-one: Secular One packs a huge midsection into every line, with no stroke variation at all. Over a long passage that sans-serif body feels dense and sturdy, a solid block of text under Megrim's spindly angular heading.
gen-megrim-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans packs its lines tight, with a high midline and an s that opens generously at its bends. A slightly larger size would give it a little more breathing room.
gen-megrim-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Megrim's strokes end at one measured thickness, and its c opens like a bent paperclip. But Sofia Sans Condensed is the workhorse here, a sans with a big x-height and unshaded curves that stay approachable.
gen-megrim-gf-spline-sans-mono: Megrim brings angular, futuristic display lettering, every stroke at one measured thickness and its x-height reaching skyward. And Spline Sans Mono follows in fixed-width monospace, so a long passage ticks along precise and technical.
gen-megrim-gf-strait: Strait reads friendly and contemporary, its lowercase bowls big and round. A long passage in this sans feels soft and open, a nice release after Megrim's angular, futuristic heading.
gen-megrim-gf-tiny5: Megrim's most striking habit is its single pen-tip line, angular and futuristic, with no calligraphic shading anywhere. Tiny5 keeps a plain sans manner underneath, so a long passage feels clean and easygoing.
